issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be static (shared across instances) while the provided solution implements calculateTotalPrice as an instance method (non-static). This discrepancy between the specification and the solution can confuse students about whether the method should be declared static and may cause test or design mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the specification. Either: (A) change the SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice signature to be static (public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) so it matches the problem statement's requirement that the method uses shared stock and is static; or (B) if the intended design is for an instance method, update the problem statement (and UML) to remove the static requirement and clarify that calculateTotalPrice is an instance method. Ensure tests and documentation reflect the chosen design.
